title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace

entities.name: The Quiet Furnace
entities.description: The Phyrexian faction associated with red mana, dwelling in the Furnace Layer of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The praetor of the Furnace Layer, who decreed that the Mirran refugees be left alone.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A relatively new interstitial layer between Mirrodin's outer surface and inner core, home to red-aligned Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane being transformed into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The brutal and horrific invaders transforming Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native inhabitants of Mirrodin, some of whom flee into the lacunae.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure with whom Urabrask seeks no audience; mentioned as one of the Phyrexian leaders' circle.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane who gives Urabrask little thought.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who approves of Urabrask's free-roaming creatures.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose orthodoxy sees Urabrask as a glorified factory boss.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose researchers suspect Urabrask has another agenda.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A sylvok healer immune to phyresis, on whose life the future of Mirrodin may depend.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: A figure who described a young tree to Melira.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A lacuna and the Great Furnace on Mirrodin's surface, now fully Phyrexian.

entities.name: Slagmaw
entities.description: The largest resistance camp, inside the husk of a dead living furnace near the Great Furnace.

entities.name: Lowlight
entities.description: A resistance encampment named by leonin abunas, close to the Cave of Light.

entities.name: Seedling
entities.description: A resistance camp near the site of the Radix, named after Thrun's young tree.

events.summary: Furnace denizens cooperate minimally with the Phyrexian invasion of Mirrodin's surface.
events.quote: they aided exactly as much as asked and no more.

events.summary: Mirrans retreat into the lacunae when outnumbered on the surface.
events.quote: they retreated into the lacunae, especially through Kuldotha and Taj-Nar

events.summary: Urabrask decrees 'Let them be' regarding the Mirran refugees, ending the killings.
events.quote: his three-word decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

events.summary: Urabrask forbids other Phyrexian factions from entering the Furnace Layer.
events.quote: No others are to enter the Furnace Layer, lest the metal be made impure

events.summary: Mirrans settle among the furnaces, learning to keep camps small and unobtrusive.
events.quote: Slowly at first, the Mirrans set up camp amid the furnaces and Phyrexians.

events.summary: The Great Furnace on the surface becomes fully Phyrexian and begins to show biological traits.
events.quote: the structure itself has begun to demonstrate biological traits

events.summary: Urabrask deploys predators and constructs in the Oxidda Mountains as intrusion countermeasures.

relations.quote: The sentient beings appealed to their praetor, Urabrask, for guidance.

relations.note: regarded as serving the Great Work
relations.quote: serving the Great Work in toil and fire

relations.note: immune healer on whom resistance depends
resistance camp near the Great Furnace
relations.quote: This is the largest of the camps, situated near the Great Furnace.
